generalInquiriesText: If you are looking to inquire about appointments, you will be automatically directed to the team after selecting four details. This system is designed to answer quick questions first, helping us suggest the best match for your needs.
medicareText1: To access Medicare rebates for your sessions, you will need a referral and a specific structured care plan from your General Practitioner (GP). Depending on your diagnosis, your GP may issue a Mental Health Care Plan (MHCP), which covers up to 10 rebated individual sessions per calendar year, or an Eating Disorder Management Plan (EDMP), which provides access to up to 40 rebated psychological treatment sessions within a 12-month period.
medicareText2: Our practice ethos is to keep quality mental health care accessible; therefore, we always aim to ensure your out-of-pocket (gap) expense does not exceed $100 AUD per session. If you do not hold a Medicare card or lack coverage through alternative third-party funding—such as an Employee Assistance Program (EAP) or private health insurance—we will match you with a qualified professional whose private fee structure aligns perfectly with your budget, ensuring you still only pay $100 AUD out of pocket.
couplesTherapyFeesText: Please note that Couples Therapy is billed at a flat rate of $140 AUD per session. Unlike individual therapy, couples and family consultations are strictly private services in Australia. This means they are completely out-of-pocket expenses and cannot be subsidised by Medicare rebates, EAP funding, or other institutional third-party payees.
ndisFundingText1: For participants under the National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS), we offer services aligned with your specific funding goals.
ndisFundingText2: Depending on your NDIS plan, you can request treatment funded under Psychosocial Recovery Coaching (focused on capacity-building and resilience for severe mental health conditions) or standard Capacity-Building Support (aimed at developing independence and daily living skills).
workCoverText2: ​Typically, insurer approval is granted initially for an assessment session. Following this first appointment, we complete and submit a clinical report requesting approval for a specific number of treatment sessions based on the clinical assessment.
workCoverText3: Once approval is granted, we invoice the insurer or employer directly, so there are no out-of-pocket costs for the client for approved sessions.
privateHealthText1: ​If you have private health insurance, you may be eligible for a rebate on your sessions.
privateHealthText2: ​Clients without Medicare: You can claim your sessions through your private health fund, depending on your level of cover.
privateHealthText3: ​Clients with Medicare: Please note that Australian regulations do not allow claiming a Medicare rebate and a Private Health Insurance rebate for the same session. However, you can choose which coverage to use for each appointment.
privateHealthText4: ​We recommend checking with your health fund prior to your appointment to confirm the exact rebate amount your specific policy provides for psychological services. ​How it works: Firstly, you pay for the session, then we will issue an itemised receipt containing all necessary provider details. You can then submit this receipt directly to your insurer to claim your rebate.
couplesTherapyCost: Sessions are billed at $140 AUD and can be in-person or online.
couplesTherapyIntro: Matías De Ambrosio offers a distinctive and highly specialized approach to couples therapy, moving away from conventional methods. Rather than assigning standard homework tasks or behavioral exercises to perform at home, his practice shifts the focus entirely toward the live dynamic within the therapeutic session.
couplesCoreFocusText: The clinical interviews are structured around the immediate emotional and communicative reality of the couple. Matías focuses deeply on:
couplesCoreFocus1: Affective Exploration: Investigating what each member of the couple genuinely feels and expresses in the room.
couplesCoreFocus2: Communication Patterns: Deconstructing how the couple interacts and rebuilding a shared language.
couplesCoreFocus3: Conflict Resolution: Navigating disagreements, addressing underlying tensions, and fostering mutual understanding.
couplesSpecializationText: Matías's practice is highly inclusive and adapted to contemporary relationship structures, providing safe, expert containment for a diverse range of clients:
couplesSpecialization1: Diverse Couple Configurations: Extensive experience working with bilingual couples (navigating cultural and linguistic nuances), traditional couples, LGBTQ+ relationships, and neurodivergent couples (tailoring communication styles to varied cognitive processing profiles).
couplesSpecialization2: Complex Family Dynamics: Deep clinical understanding of intricate systemic family structures and interpersonal conflicts.
couplesConclusion: Through this clinical framework, therapy becomes a profound space for insight and structural change, focusing on real-time resolution rather than prescriptive behavioral management.
matiasBio1: Matías is a highly qualified Mental Health Professional with over 15 years of clinical experience. While he holds a registered and specialized license as a Clinical Psychologist in Argentina, he operates within our clinic in Australia as a Senior Counsellor. Drawing on systemic, relational, and communication-focused frameworks, he specializes in deconstructing complex interpersonal dynamics and facilitating conflict resolution. His extensive clinical background includes managing acute psychiatric presentations, high-conflict relationship breakdowns, domestic violence, and family complexity.
matiasHospitalBio: He worked at the General Acute Care Hospital of Berisso, Argentina, for four years, followed by another four years of clinical practice at the Private Neuropsychiatric Clinic La Plata, Argentina. This extensive institutional experience within both public health and acute psychiatric frameworks strengthened his capacity for crisis intervention, comprehensive risk assessment, and complex case management.
matiasAcademicBio: Alongside his clinical practice, Matías has a prominent background in academia. He has served as a university lecturer and Chief of Practical Works in psychology and complex systems curricula, as well as a scientific researcher in community health. Furthermore, he brings strong experience in professional mentorship, having supervised and served as a jury member for numerous bachelor theses for psychology students overseas. He is also a published author, with chapters and papers focusing on psychosis, clinical transference, and mental health frameworks.
matiasCulturalBio: Originally from Argentina, where he graduated from the National University of La Plata and earned his specialization as a Clinical Psychology Specialist, Matías offers sessions in Spanish and English. He provides culturally responsive and linguistically accessible care, maintaining a reflective, ethical, and collaborative therapeutic environment tailored to the unique recovery trajectory of each individual, couple, or family.
successMessage: Thank you for sending your request to be contacted by the Counselling & Clinical Psychology WA team. You will hear from us soon to answer all your queries, discuss possible appointment times, and explore options for you to start therapy as soon as possible.
indivTherapySubtitle: Let us help you find the professional that best fits your needs.
indivTherapyIntro: Click the button below to answer four quick questions, allowing us to tailor our recommendation just for you. Rest reassured that after our suggestion you will be able to accept it or to ask for another professional of your choice.
celesteBio1: Celeste is a PhD-qualified Clinical Psychologist, with 17 years of clinical experience. She supports adults and teens aged 16 years and over, drawing on trauma-informed, attachment-based, and strengths-focused frameworks. She has experience working with most presentations, including Complex PTSD, BPD, Bipolar Disorder, ADHD and Autism. Celeste also works with Dissociative Disorders and depersonalization. Moreover, she offers gender and neuro affirming therapy. If you have NDIS, been hospitalized or in psychiatric treatment, don't hesitate booking for a session.
celesteBio2: Celeste supervises papers for several peer-reviewed Journals of Psychology from different countries, as well as bachelor and PhD thesis from Argentinian colleagues. You can read her papers on dreams, death, psychosis and more issues on scholar google.
celesteBio3: Originally from Argentina, she offers sessions in Spanish and English, providing culturally responsive and linguistically accessible care within a bilingual therapeutic space. She is committed to providing a reflective, ethical, collaborative, and culturally safe therapeutic environment, grounded in respect and inclusive practice.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Counselling and Clinical Psychology WA ('we', 'us', 'our') collects, uses, discloses, and protects your personal information in accordance with the Privacy Act 1988 (Cth) and the Australian Privacy Principles (APPs). By using our website and services, you agree to the practices described in this policy.
privacy.s1Text: We may collect the following types of personal information: contact details you provide to us (such as your name, email address, and phone number); information you submit through our enquiry forms, including details about your health coverage and treatment needs; health and sensitive information where necessary to provide psychological services; and technical information such as your IP address and usage data collected automatically when you visit our website.
privacy.s2Text: We use your personal information to respond to enquiries and schedule appointments; to provide, manage, and improve our psychological services; to process billing, invoices, and rebates (including Medicare, NDIS, WorkCover, and private health insurance); to communicate with you about your care; and to comply with our legal and professional obligations.
privacy.s3Text: We do not sell or rent your personal information. We may disclose your information to third parties only where necessary, including to practitioners involved in your care, health insurers and funding bodies (such as Medicare, the NDIS, WorkCover, or private health funds) where you request or authorise us to do so, to service providers who assist us in operating our practice (such as email and communication platforms), or where disclosure is required or authorised by law.
privacy.s4Text: Health information is treated with particular care and is used only for the purposes described in this policy. Your information is kept strictly confidential. Legal exceptions include situations where there is an imminent risk of serious harm to you or others, where disclosure is required by a court order or subpoena, or where otherwise required or authorised by law.
privacy.s5Text: We take reasonable steps to protect your personal information from misuse, interference, loss, unauthorised access, modification, or disclosure, using appropriate technical and organisational measures. We retain your information only for as long as necessary to provide our services and to meet our legal and professional record-keeping obligations.
privacy.s6Text: Our website may use cookies and similar technologies to improve your browsing experience and to understand how our website is used. You can control or disable cookies through your browser settings. Our website may contain links to external websites, which are not governed by this Privacy Policy.
privacy.s7Text: You have the right to request access to the personal information we hold about you and to request correction of information that is inaccurate, incomplete, or out of date. To make a request, please contact us using the details below. We will respond to your request within a reasonable timeframe.
privacy.s8Text: If you believe we have not complied with the Australian Privacy Principles, please contact us and we will investigate and respond to your complaint. If you are not satisfied with our response, you may make a complaint to the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner (OAIC) at www.oaic.gov.au.
privacy.s9Text: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your personal information, please contact us at admin@counsellingandclinicalpsychologywa.com.au.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.intro: These Terms and Conditions ('Terms') govern your use of the website of Counselling and Clinical Psychology WA and the services we provide. By using our website, submitting an enquiry form, or booking an appointment, you agree to be bound by these Terms.
terms.s1Text: By accessing our website or using our services, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agree to these Terms. If you do not agree with any part of these Terms, please do not use our website or services.
terms.s2Text: Our services include psychological therapy, counselling, and related assessments provided by qualified health professionals. Information on our website is provided for general information only and does not constitute professional advice. You should always seek professional guidance tailored to your individual circumstances.
terms.s3Text: Our services are not an emergency or crisis service. If you or someone else is in immediate danger, call 000 (Triple Zero) in Australia. For 24/7 crisis support, contact Lifeline on 13 11 14 or Beyond Blue on 1300 22 4636.
terms.s4Text: Appointments can be booked by contacting us through our website or by other means we make available. We will confirm appointment details with you. Please arrive on time, as late arrival may reduce the length of your session.
terms.s5Text: Fees for our services are communicated to you prior to your appointment. Individual therapy is billed at the fee applicable to your practitioner, and couples therapy is billed at a flat rate of $140 AUD per session. Where applicable, rebates may be claimed through Medicare, private health insurance, the NDIS, or WorkCover, subject to the relevant eligibility criteria. You are responsible for any out-of-pocket expenses not covered by these arrangements.
terms.s6Text: We understand that circumstances change. Please provide as much notice as possible (ideally at least 48 hours) if you need to cancel or reschedule an appointment. Fees for missed appointments without prior notice may be charged at the discretion of the clinic. Refunds are assessed on a case-by-case basis in accordance with applicable law.
terms.s7Text: Your personal and health information is kept strictly confidential in accordance with our Privacy Policy and applicable law. Confidentiality has limited exceptions, including where there is a risk of serious harm, or where disclosure is required by law.
terms.s8Text: Where telehealth sessions are offered, you are responsible for ensuring you are in a private, safe, and technically suitable environment. Telehealth services are subject to the same professional and ethical standards as in-person sessions.
terms.s9Text: All content on our website, including text, graphics, logos, and images, is owned by or licensed to Counselling and Clinical Psychology WA and is protected by copyright and other intellectual property laws. You may not reproduce, distribute, or use this content without our prior written consent.
terms.s10Text: To the maximum extent permitted by law, Counselling and Clinical Psychology WA and its practitioners are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential loss or damage arising from your use of our website or services. Nothing in these Terms limits any rights you may have under Australian consumer law.
terms.s11Text: These Terms are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of Western Australia and the Commonwealth of Australia. Any disputes are subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Western Australia.
terms.s12Text: We may update these Terms from time to time. The most current version will always be published on this page, and continued use of our website or services after changes are posted constitutes acceptance of the updated Terms.
terms.s13Text: If you have any questions about these Terms, please contact us at admin@counsellingandclinicalpsychologywa.com.au.
